Hi Amy / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have a single mutual action plan and can map owners on your side:

- Business outcome: 6-week pilot to validate latency and cost on guarded PHI-like workloads; goal is to integrate inference into clinical-safety checks and reduce review time by 30%.
- Expected pilot users: 8 internal analysts (non-production data), then ramp to 25 in Q1.
- Key decision criteria you called out: security posture (SOC 2 + pen test), auditability (retention of request logs and KV cache metadata), and predictable unit cost.

Stakeholder map (from today):
- Economic buyer: Tom Jacobs (CFO) — cost/SLA authority
- Security reviewer: Jordan White (InfoSec) — technical evidence and pen test scope
- Procurement: procurement@rylandsmedical.com — T&Cs and SOW
- Day-to-day champion: Amy Reynolds — pilot owner

Immediate asks we agreed on:
1) Deliver SOC 2 report and a short pen test scope summary (by EOD tomorrow).
2) Confirm audit log retention options and data retention policy for ephemeral KV cache.
3) Share a simple mutual action plan (dates / owners) so you can circulate to Tom and Procurement.

Attachments: I have attached Redwood_SOC2_Report_v2.pdf and PenTest_Scope_Summary.pdf. Karthik has also included a short AuditLog-FAQ.docx in CC (see below).

Next steps / proposed schedule:
- Wed 12/2 — (Redwood) provide SOC 2 + pen test summary + audit log FAQ (delivered)
- Fri 12/4 — 30-min technical walk with Jordan (Karthik to lead)
- Tue 12/8 — 20-min alignment with Tom on commercial ask (Jasmine leading)

Are these dates feasible for you? If there's a separate procurement contact I should loop in directly, please reply with that email and any required procurement templates.

Thanks — look forward to moving this forward.

Best,

Hi Amy / Tom / Jordan (when Jordan joins) —

Following up with concrete answers to the audit/pen test/residency questions:

1) Audit logs and retention
- What we log: request & response metadata by default (timestamps, model, route, token count), request hash for deduplication, and full prompt text only if the customer opts into "logging for quality". For the pilot we recommend enabling "metadata-only" logs; prompts can be redacted automatically.
- Retention options: configurable per-account. Out of the box: 90 days; configurable windows supported: 30, 90, 365 days, or custom via Dedicated/Private deployments.
- Export & audits: logs can be exported as CSV or ingested to your SIEM via secure S3 integration (pre-signed URLs + KMS). We provide an AuditLog-FAQ.docx that covers format and access controls (attached).

2) Pen test status and approach
- Completed tests: Redwood maintains internal red-team results and a third-party continuous scanning contract, but we do not publish full third-party reports publicly.
- For customers: we offer one of two paths: (A) share a scoped executive summary (non-sensitive) and MOU for a customer-triggered third-party engagement, or (B) arrange a redacted third-party report under NDA.
- Timeline: if Rylands prefers an on-demand customer third-party test, typical scheduling is 4-6 weeks from kickoff. If you want Redwood to provide a redacted report, we can share a high-level summary within 48 hours.

3) Data residency
- Hosted (Redwood API / Hosted mode): metadata and logs for US accounts are stored in our US regions (AWS us-west-2). We can provide region-specific storage guarantees for Dedicated or Private deployments. For the pilot we can confirm US-only storage.

Quick note on attachments / links:
- AuditLog-FAQ.docx (attached) contains field-by-field examples and the CSV schema for exports.
- Architecture diagram (read-only) at: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/rylands/architecture-diagram.png

Action items I can take this week:
- Prepare the short executive security summary (non-sensitive) for Jordan to review (deliver by EOD 12/2).
- If you want a redacted third-party pen test summary, Jasmine can coordinate an NDA and we'll share within 48 hours after NDA.

If Jordan prefers a technical call, I can run the session and demo the export flow to your SIEM. Proposed slots: Fri 12/4 10:00-10:30 PT or Mon 12/7 09:00-09:30 PT.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
